div.head: Hu 7.1
div.ab: Et qui terminum illum fregerit — nisi sit pro banno domini uel infirmitate monstrabili —, XXX sol. emendet, et ad constitutum diem faciat quod ante debuerat.
⁊ se ðe ðone andagan brece — buton hit sy ðurh hlafordes geban —, gebete mid XXX scill', ⁊ to gesetton dæge gelæste þæt he ær sceolde.
Qui illas inducias fregerit (quas auctoritas totius centuriatus statuit), nisi sit propter edictum domini (sui), emendet hoc XXX sol., et statuto termino (alio) perficiat quod prius deberet.
⁊ se ðe ðone andagan brece—buton hit sy ðurh hlafordes geban—gebete mid XXX scill', ⁊ to gesetton dæge gelæste þæt he ær sceolde.
And he who fails to appear at the appointed time—unless prevented by a summons from his lord—shall pay 30 shillings as compensation and perform on a fixed date what he should have done before.
Und wer diesen Termin bricht — ausser wenn es wegen Aufgebots durch [seinen] Herrn geschieht —, büsse mit 30 Schill. und leiste zum [neu] bestimmten Tage, was er vorher gesollt hätte.
And whoever breaks this term — unless it is because of a summons by [his] lord —, let him pay 30 shillings and perform on the [newly] appointed day what he should have done before.
